d:
This time our guest in Guest in the Newsroom is Prakash Raj who won hearts with his villainous roles in films like Singham and Wanted. He spoke openly on politics including PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal. There was a detailed discussion on food as well. Watch this special episode with Saurabh Dwivedi to see what he said about Kunal Kamra.
